REFUTED: contradicted - docs/cycle27-plan.md:3679-3680 (Pre-decided 129) says the 11 wires "still hold a live endpoint on WhileLoop #637, so deleting them drops real data paths", which does not cover w1731/w3947/w9635 on the completed graph because that premise is measured false there: `tools/bench/m3a4_reverify.log` rows w1731/w3947/w9635 show each is a HALF-WIRE with no sink (bed_wire_state=half-wire), and the S1 sink it used to feed (#48 'VISA resource name', #48 'In position', #9623 '# slices in stack') is fed live in the bed by #23880/#23909/#24035 with effective sources EQUAL to S1's (eff_eq=True). Deleting a sinkless half-wire removes no data path; the later, specific Pre-decided 142 (`docs/connectivity-map-plan.md:92`, the brief's governing line) prescribes exactly this delete. The 131(3) "batches of 3-4 rows, each saved" clause (`docs/cycle27-plan.md:3702`) governs RE-WIRING batches; step 6 re-wires nothing (142: "a RETIREMENT, not a re-wiring") and 142(d) prescribes the single save `claudeDev\D1_s3b_m3a4_<date>.vi`; the step's intermediate artefacts are `tools/bench/decision_m3a4_v2.json` (6.0) and that VI. Whether PD129/131(3) should carry a written "superseded by 142 for M3a-4" note is left to judgement (material OPEN).
